Observed Data Path.finding: 64.1 MiB were read from nvme1n1 during the run (all processes using the device).

Diagnosis.check: Host-staged reads despite an active direct route
Diagnosis.finding: gdscheck reports the nvidia-fs route active for this filesystem, yet no read in this run reached GPU memory directly while 64.1 MiB were read from the device. The data went through host memory, so the cause is in the application or an I/O library rather than the platform.
Diagnosis.mitigation: Check whether the application or a library stages reads in host memory: an I/O library cache (HDF5's raw-data chunk cache stages chunks that fit in it), file descriptors opened without O_DIRECT, or reads below a library's GDS size threshold. To attribute each read to the operation that issued it, trace the run with a per-operation tracer such as GDSight (https://github.com/izzet/gdsight).
